title: Original type 0x9f sound-action recovery
scope: First-scene S0 sound command plus selector-defined type-0x9f body and phase lifecycle; not a whole audio-engine or decoder claim.

original_executable.pseudocode_status: Ghidra pseudocode is unverified; machine disassembly and Unicorn execution are cited separately.

control_word.semantics: retained raw; copied to CSound channel +0x134 and used by DirectSound flags/restart code

attenuation.conversion: 0x50ce04 changes x87 rounding to truncation toward zero
attenuation.note: Scalar roles are intentionally neutral; both outputs are independently derived.

control_word_alias.device_pointer_store: 0x4f2710 stores its second argument at CDirectSound + 0x3ce
control_word_alias.alias: CDirectSound per-slot +0x130 == CSound per-channel +0x134; CDirectSound +0x12c == CSound +0x130
control_word_alias.play_flags: 0x4f6059 chooses flags and calls 0x4f80d3; that wrapper calls DirectSoundBuffer vtable +0x30
control_word_alias.restart: 0x4f55d5 can restart when the raw word is zero; random-repeat flag path remains unresolved
control_word_alias.native_policy: retain raw word and return explicit backend unsupported for unimplemented control/restart combinations

captions.phase_gate: global caption enabled && dispatch argument nonzero && signed runtime length > 0
captions.native_policy: resolver NO_RESOURCE becomes exact fallback; missing presenter returns unsupported

phases.phase_0: optional typed caption; load and play after successful load; direct completion iff transition=9999, event flag=-1 and raw control word=0; else phase=1
phases.phase_1: mode=1 advances to phase 2; otherwise query and advance only when stopped
phases.phase_2: non-9999 transition requests engine state 4 and scene flag 1; unload only mode=0; subtype 1 completes, subtype 2 clears completion and resets dependency tree; phase=0
phases.false_dependency_gate: subtype 2 clears completion and phase only; no dependency-tree reset

oracle.play_flag_scope: flags0 belong to the controlled non-streaming buffer fixture; actual HIS streaming/loop-buffer behavior is unverified

limitations: Original scene action-resource loading and successful auto-text lookup are not executed by this sound oracle; runtime receives a fallback caption fixture sourced from GAME.EXE.
HIS decode, Windows file/device operations, DirectSound device creation, real playback, and audible output are not validated.
Only category 0 master volume 0.85f is compared for S0; other runtime volume configurations are not claimed.
Control-word-zero restart/random-delay behavior, streaming, other audio flag combinations, other playback modes, and successful caption content are not implemented by this kernel subset.
The corpus only has selector 0 or 0xffff; nonzero numeric literal captions are accepted by the loader rule but do not have corpus coverage.
